svg.title: One shared browser runtime, two language front ends
svg.desc: A hand-drawn sketch. At the bottom, exlibris, the shared browser runtime, holds the workspace (editor, console, files and plots), the driver contract and the ViewerConfig schema, and builds two bundles, exlibris-r.js and exlibris-py.js. Above it, webrarian, the R front end, vendors exlibris-r.js, and pyodidarian, the Python front end, vendors exlibris-py.js. Both write the same window.__VIEWER_CONFIG__ into the page they generate, and the bundle reads it at startup.
